edge.title: Drop Muon momentum (mu=0): orthogonalized raw gradient, 8500 steps
edge.summary: Muon is run with mu=0, so momentum.lerp_(grad, 1) just copies the current gradient and Newton–Schulz orthogonalizes the raw minibatch gradient each step (stochastic spectral descent); the Nesterov branch is removed from muon_update. With lr=0.03 and wd=0.015 it needs 8225 steps (read 275 steps before the 8500-step schedule ends), about 2.5x #12's 3325, which isolates how much Muon gains from momentum. The README notes this equals Shampoo with betas=(0, 0), precondition_frequency=1 and power −1/4.

changes.label: Momentum removed (mu=0)
changes.detail: optimizer2 = Muon(..., mu=0); muon_update now orthogonalizes `momentum` directly (Nesterov blend deleted), and with mu=0 momentum.lerp_(grad, 1) equals the current gradient.

changes.label: lr 0.035 → 0.03, wd 0.025 → 0.015
changes.detail: optimizer2 = Muon(lr=0.03, weight_decay=0.015, mu=0): decoupled shrink lr·wd 4.5e-4 per step at peak (was 8.75e-4).

changes.label: Steps 3350/3325 → 8500/8225
changes.detail: train_steps=8500 with the result read at 8225, 275 steps before the end (lr ≈ 4.6% of peak).

edge.parent_check: Consistent: a three-line edit of #12's Muon script. The README frames it equally as Shampoo with zero betas (the #21 family), but the code path is Muon.

techniques.note: Muon class with mu=0: NS (12 iters) of the raw gradient, lr 0.03, wd 0.015
claimed at 8225 of 8500 scheduled (lr ≈ 4.6% of peak)
proj weights zero (incl. LM head); all biases zero

hparams.init.hidden_std: normal, std 0.33**0.5 / fan_in**0.5 ≈ 0.0207 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)

mechanisms.name: Stochastic spectral descent
mechanisms.explain: Each step replaces the minibatch gradient G = UΣVᵀ of every hidden matrix by its polar factor ≈UVᵀ (12 Newton–Schulz iterations), scales it by sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)) and applies it with decoupled decay, with no averaging over steps. It is steepest descent under the spectral norm and equals (GGᵀ)^-1/4·G·(GᵀG)^-1/4, i.e. Shampoo with zero betas.

caveats: Run on 1×H200 (world_size 1, 8 micro-batches accumulated per step), which gives the same 524288-token batch by construction. The 275-step early stop is unusually large (lr still ≈4.6% of peak at the readout). n=4, mean 3.2774 at 8225.
